$description: Binding of this design-repo to the N0 common design policy (Common Composition IR v0.5). The classification is an agent decision from the clone's own evidence; every ref below is re-read from the source tree by extraction/verify_all.py (policy-binding) when that tree is present. registry.manifest.json designPolicy points here and carries the contentHash of the files this policy is enforced by.

classification.marketModel: B2B enterprise platform sold through sales under a Master Service Agreement; consumption-based pricing; delivered as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant or bring-your-own-cloud
audiences: regulated-industry buyers (banking, telecom, insurance, airlines, utilities, healthcare, retail)
classification.decision: Classified SaaS (enterprise B2B platform), with moderate confidence. Wonderful sells a software platform (AI OS, Agents, Systems, AI Gateway) that enterprises use to build, test, deploy and monitor AI agents; the product page states multi-tenant SaaS as a deployment option, the industry copy states consumption-based pricing, and the legal stack is an MSA with SLA, DPA and regulatory addenda. It is not a self-serve SaaS: there is no pricing page, no sign-up or log-in route and no free tier, the only conversion path is a sales-qualification contact form, and forward-deployed engineering teams are part of the offer. The binding therefore applies the common SaaS constraints to an enterprise-sales marketing surface and asks the architecture owner to ratify or reclassify it.

evidence.claim: deployment options include multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant and BYOC
service-level commitments for a hosted service

evidence.quote: build, test, deploy, and monitor AI agents
evidence.claim: the product is a platform for building, testing, deploying and monitoring agents
four product lines presented as software products

counterEvidence.claim: no pricing, sign-up or log-in route exists among the 103 sitemap routes (an absence, so it cannot be quoted from a line)
the only conversion path is a sales-qualification form (industry, company size, country)

generationRules: PageSpecs declare mode reference | generated (schema-required, closed). mode=generated pages may not contain Wonderful identity, copy, claims, people, customers, URLs, store marks, ratings or blocked / reference-only assets (GENERATED_MODE_* in schema/semantic_validate.py; patterns in schema/source-brand.json; availability pinned in code).
Pages are composed only from the 20 templates and the section contracts they list; node order, variants, slots and graph rules are enforced in both modes.
Style references are catalog tokens only (TOKEN_* rules); motion uses the closed motion patterns with a required reduced-motion fallback.

Runtime UI (cookie banner, menus, lightbox, ticker, language chip) is never retrievable page content (RETRIEVAL_PIN); no section may hold most of a page (extraction/wrapper_gate.py over measured heights).
Compliance claims, ratings and customer proof are never fabricated: generated pages use fictional or operator-supplied proof only.
contentHashNote: registry.manifest.json designPolicy.contentHash = sha256 over the files listed in enforcedBy (sorted by path; each contributes its path, a NUL byte, its bytes and a NUL byte). verify_all.py recomputes it. The text of the common policy n0-saas-design-constraints-common is not shipped here and was not available to this build, so the hash covers this repo's enforcing files, not the common policy document.

approval.note: The SaaS classification and the binding are an agent decision from the evidence above (agent attestation, not a human sign-off). A human architecture owner must ratify it; productionApproved stays false.
